A first guide to the living colony.
category.infestusfrontier.contact.name: First Contact
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.the_wakin: This guide covers the starting ingredients and how the colony grows only where you choose. Each page names what you need first. Nothing here is required to play. Read a page when you want to know what to do next.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.organ_bud: A blank that becomes an organ
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.speak_to_: Read an organ without opening it
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.a_culture: Rotten flesh, a red mushroom and wheat seeds.
Use Spore Culture on exposed dirt, grass, mud or stone to turn it into basic Living Substrate. Lost this book? Craft it again from a book and one Spore Culture.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.living_su: Dirt and Spore Culture make one cell to place.

Bone meal grows a cell. The fed cell matures and converts the ground beside it: a mature core, a young ring, a basic edge. Bone meal the edge to grow on. Cells never spread on their own. A broken cell keeps its stage.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.organ_bud: Spore Culture, two rotten flesh and bone meal.
Place a Bud on Living Substrate. Craft an organ from it. The Culture Bowl grows Buds in batches.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.digestive: An Organ Bud, two rotten flesh and a bowl.
Place it on Living Substrate. Feed it by hand or by hopper: wheat gives 100 BU in 2 seconds, rotten flesh 50 BU in 8. An empty bucket takes 1000 BU. Any other item opens the screen. A full Sac waits.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.biomass_b: An Organ Bud, two glass and a slime ball.
Holds 4000 BU. A biomass bucket pours in, an empty bucket takes out. A Sac beside it fills it on its own. Any other item opens the screen.
An empty bucket on a Sac or a Bladder takes 1000 BU. Use the full bucket on a Bladder or a Bowl to pour it in. One BU is one mB.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.culture_b: A flower pot, Spore Culture and wheat seeds.

Place it on Living Substrate. Put ingredients in one at a time and a water bucket for water. Any other item opens the screen; press Start. Sneak with both hands empty to take a stack back. A batch takes 60 seconds.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.speak_to_: A bone, a slime ball and Spore Culture.

Use the Probe on an organ to read its biomass without opening the screen. Any other item, or an empty hand, opens the screen: what the organ holds and the buttons that start work. Sneak to build against an organ.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.membrane_: Place it on Living Substrate. Put in rotten flesh or leather, string, and a water bucket. Any other item opens the screen; press Start. A sheet takes 20 seconds from flesh, 40 from leather. Sneak with both hands empty to take a stack back.
Two sticks, two bones and Spore Culture.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.bone_loom: Place it on Living Substrate. Put in a bone and a bucket of biomass. Any other item opens the screen; press Start. A plate takes 20 seconds and 50 BU. Biomass binds the bone; it does not make it. Sneak with both hands empty to take a stack back.
An Organ Bud, two bones and two sticks.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.dormant_p: Rotten flesh in the shape of a helmet, chestplate, leggings or boots makes a dormant piece. It is weak and holds nothing. The Cradle wakes it.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.awakening: Place it on Living Substrate. Put in one dormant piece, one Spore Culture and a bucket of biomass. Any other item opens the screen; press Start. Thirty seconds and 100 BU later the piece is awake, as worn as it went in, with an empty reserve of 40 BU.
Open a Biomass Bladder, put the awakened piece in its slot and press Fill. The Bladder moves what the piece can take, 40 BU at most, and nothing else.
An Organ Bud, two Bone Plates and two Membrane Sheets.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.awa: Wake a dormant piece in an Awakening Cradle.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.roo: The colony begins with a single culture.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.liv: Use a Spore Culture on exposed ground.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.org: Craft or grow an Organ Bud, a blank that becomes an organ.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.dig: Digest a batch in a Digestive Sac for your first fuel; a full Sac pauses instead of spilling.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.bio: Pour a bucket of biomass into a Biomass Bladder to store it.
